annotations.title: Estimate MOT pass odds by age and mileage

description: Odds that a used car passes its next MOT first time, for its age and mileage, counted from DVSA's own MOT test records with odometer readings (Great Britain) — and how those odds move one mileage band lower or higher for a car of the same age. Pass make and model as well: for the models we cover it adds that model's pass rate at the same mileage, compared fairly against cars of the same ages, and it says plainly when a model is not covered rather than guessing. It is a rate across the tested fleet, not a prediction for one car. Use when someone asks whether a high-mileage car will pass its MOT, how much mileage matters for an MOT, or whether a particular used car is likely to need MOT work.

age_years.description: Age in whole years, only if the registration year is not known.

make.description: Manufacturer, e.g. "Ford". Optional, but needed (with model) for the model-level comparison.

registration_year.description: Year the car was FIRST registered (V5C), e.g. 2016. Age is counted from it the way the DVSA figures were. Preferred over age_years.
